product.title: Private Tour: Nighttime Sightseeing with River Cruise

description.text: In Singapore, this private evening circuit leaves a city hotel lobby at 6 pm for Little India, the Gardens by the Bay light show, Clarke Quay, a shared Singapore River cruise, and Marina Bay Sands SkyPark. An English-speaking guide and air-conditioned private vehicle are listed, with the SkyPark entrance and river-cruise ticket included on the published visit list. Food, dinner stops, and gratuities stay separate. The window is about three hours 30 minutes from pickup to hotel drop-off. The format suits visitors on a short layover who want guided night landmarks without buying cruise and SkyPark tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Little India, Gardens by the Bay, the Singapore River, and SkyPark that define this night outing rather than a daytime hawker walk.

highlights: Private nighttime sightseeing with hotel pickup
Little India stop plus Gardens by the Bay light show
Singapore River cruise on a shared boat
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark observation deck included
